en.headline: Tai Kwun to present Anne Imhof’s first major Asia solo show
en.dek: House of Swans opens on 25 September at JC Contemporary and runs until 3 January, with opening-week performances involving Hong Kong Ballet.
body: Tai Kwun Contemporary said it will present House of Swans, the first major solo exhibition in Asia by German artist Anne Imhof, from 25 September 2026 to 3 January 2027 across three floors of the JC Contemporary and F Hall galleries.

The venue said the show, curated by Ying Kwok and Tiffany Leung, brings together new paintings, bronze sculptures, sonic installations and video. Opening-week performances on 25 and 26 September will involve long-term collaborators of the artist and dancers from Hong Kong Ballet. Further adapted performances by the company are scheduled through October and November.

Tai Kwun said tickets are now on sale. The galleries are open from 11am to 7pm, Tuesday to Sunday. The organisation described the exhibition as a commission of monumental new works exploring gender, power and bodily discipline through staged installations and live performance.

zh.headline: 大館下月舉行Anne Imhof亞洲首個大型個展
zh.dek: 《House of Swans》9月25日至明年1月3日於JC當代空間展出，開幕周有香港茵蕾舞團參與演出。
body: 大館當代美術館表示，將於2026年9月25日至2027年1月3日，在JC當代空間及f倉三層場地舉行德國藝術家Anne Imhof亞洲首個大型個展《House of Swans》。
館方指，展覽由郭瑛及梁天恩策劃，展出新作油畫、銅雕、聲音裝置及錄像。開幕周9月25及26日將有藝術家長年合作者，以及香港茵蕾舞團舞者參與演出，10至11月另有舞團改編場次。
大館表示門票現已發售。場地開放時間為星期二至日上午11時至下午7時。館方稱這是一組大型委約新作，透過裝置與現場演出處理性別、權力與身體規訓等題材。
